description: This file defines a class for a custom HTML5-based lexer and parser, specifically the HTMLPurifier_Lexer_PH5P class that uses the PH5P library to parse HTML content with fallback mechanisms. It includes implementation of tokenization, error handling, and tree construction for HTML purification or analysis.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer_PH5P
classes.description: A class implementing an HTML5 lexer that uses the PH5P library to parse HTML content, with error handling to fallback to a different lexer.

classes.name: HTML5
classes.description: A class that implements an HTML5 parser using a state machine, capable of constructing a DOM tree from HTML input.

classes.name: HTML5TreeConstructer
classes.description: A class responsible for constructing a DOM tree during the parsing process, managing the stack of open elements and inserter modes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer_PH5P
classes.description: A class implementing an HTML5 lexer and parser that processes HTML tokens, manages parsing states, and constructs a DOM tree with error handling and scope management.

classes.name: HTML5
classes.description: Represents the HTML5 parser state machine responsible for token processing, insertion modes, and tree construction.

classes.name: HTML5TreeConstructer
classes.description: Handles the construction of the DOM tree by managing open element stacks, active formatting elements, and inserting nodes.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Method in HTMLPurifier_Lexer_PH5P that normalizes input, attempts to parse using HTML5 parser, and falls back if errors occur.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves and returns the constructed DOM document.

methods.name: emitToken
methods.description: Emits a token to the tree constructor during parsing.

methods.name: entity
methods.description: Handles HTML entity decoding within the parser.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Tokenizes input HTML content, managing parser states, handling errors, and building the DOM tree.

methods.name: inHead
methods.description: Processes tokens when inside the <head> element, managing specific tags and errors.

methods.name: inBody
methods.description: Handles tokens when in the body context, managing content insertion, scope, and special elements.

methods.name: inTable
methods.description: Implements table-specific token handling, managing table structure elements and reprocessing tokens.

methods.name: inCaption
methods.description: Handles tokens within a <caption> element, managing scope and parser state transitions.

methods.name: inColumnGroup
methods.description: Processes tokens in a <colgroup> context, managing column-based elements.

methods.name: inTableBody
methods.description: Handles processing of <tbody>, <tfoot>, and <thead> sections within a table.

methods.name: inRow
methods.description: Manages tokens within a <tr> element, controlling row and cell insertions.

methods.name: inCell
methods.description: Handles the insertion and closure of table cells (<td> and <th>), managing scope and parsing errors.

methods.name: inSelect
methods.description: Processes tokens within a select element, managing options, optgroups, and scope transitions.

methods.name: afterBody
methods.description: Handles tokens after the body content has been parsed, such as comments and the end of the HTML document.

methods.name: inFrameset
methods.description: Manages tokens within a frameset context, handling frameset, frame, and noframes elements.

methods.name: afterFrameset
methods.description: Processes tokens after the frameset content, such as comments, end of HTML, or noframes.

methods.name: trailingEndPhase
methods.description: Handles tokens after document parsing completion, such as comments, whitespace, and the EOF.

methods.name: insertElement
methods.description: Creates and inserts a new DOM element based on the given token, with optional checking and sanitization of the tag name.

methods.name: insertText
methods.description: Inserts a text node with the given data into the current DOM position.

methods.name: insertComment
methods.description: Creates and inserts a comment node with the provided data.

methods.name: appendToRealParent
methods.description: Appends a given node to the current DOM parent, considering foster parenting rules.

methods.name: elementInScope
methods.description: Checks if an element or any of the specified elements are in scope within the open elements stack, with optional table scope consideration.

methods.name: reconstructActiveFormattingElements
methods.description: Rebuilds the list of active formatting elements as needed, cloning and stacking nodes.

methods.name: clearTheActiveFormattingElementsUpToTheLastMarker
methods.description: Removes entries from the active formatting elements list up to the last marker.

methods.name: generateImpliedEndTags
methods.description: Generates implied end tags for certain elements, optionally excluding specified tags.

methods.name: getElementCategory
methods.description: Determines the category (special, scoping, formatting, phrasing) of a DOM node based on its tag name.

methods.name: clearStackToTableContext
methods.description: Pops elements from the open elements stack until a table context is reached, with parse error handling.

methods.name: resetInsertionMode
methods.description: Resets the insertion mode based on the current stack, following the HTML5 spec for re-parsing after implied elements closure.

methods.name: closeCell
methods.description: Closes a table cell (<td> or <th>) if one exists in scope.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Returns the constructed DOM Document object.
